scope.reviewType: one bounded affected-only saved-capture pixel review
checks: Visible fraction bars and numerator/denominator separation
Adjacent prose, punctuation and equation-number spacing
Absence of visible formula-wrapper clipping or overlap
scope.appliesTo: Only the eight hash-bound saved PNGs and their hash-bound DOM report; no live page or independently inspected current CSS.
excluded: Repeat of prior complete desktop/mobile display approval

imageBatch.handoff: Textual verdict and existing evidence paths/hashes only; reuse this review without reopening the batch.

domReport.evidenceUse: Existing DOM evidence reused, not rerun or modified. This review supplies only the pending affected pixel verdict.

observations: At overview scale the low-speed derivation, Einstein relation and rest-energy formulas stay inside the text column, with distinct formula lines and no visible collisions with surrounding paragraphs.
The multiplier in prose and equation labels (8.11)-(8.15) remain visually separate from neighboring text; no visible right-edge truncation.
Overview coverage includes the low-speed mass approximation and later rest-energy identity not fully covered by every targeted viewport capture.
captures.limitation: Tall full-page overview cannot certify every fine glyph; the three desktop viewport captures provide the detailed affected-formula observations below.

observations: Both radicals in the denominator rewrite show continuous bars, visible lower hooks and clearance above the nested fractions and raised square.
The inline fourth-order fraction after 'small quantity' is separated from the prose and 'gives:'; its fraction bars and raised fourth powers are visible without overlap.
The shorter radical approximation and the mass fraction following 'Therefore:' have distinct numerator/denominator levels and clear space above and below.
The visible parenthesized multiplier near the bottom is separate from its adjacent prose.
captures.limitation: The viewport ends during the multiplier paragraph; lower content outside the capture is not a wrapper-clipping finding.

observations: The visible kinetic-energy and mass-change expressions remain on the prose baseline with spaces around adjacent commas and words; the following mass-change fraction has clear separation from its next paragraph.
Equation (8.12) shows a clear main fraction bar, denominator radical and nested squared ratio; the numerator and raised c-squared remain distinct.
The (8.12) label has a visible gap after the formula, and the bold paragraph below does not collide with the denominator radical.
captures.limitation: Equation (8.11) touches the top capture boundary and (8.13) is at the bottom boundary; those boundary fragments are not used to certify fine-glyph completeness.

observations: The inline low-speed inequality in parentheses is distinct from adjoining prose.
Equation (8.14) has a clear kinetic-term fraction bar, a separate denominator 2 and visible squared terms; the label and following paragraph have clearance.
The inline rest-energy symbol before the colon and equation (8.15) show distinct lowered zero indices and raised squares, with no visible collision with neighboring text or the equation label.
captures.limitation: The final paragraph continues past the bottom screen edge; unseen continuation is outside this viewport observation.

observations: At overview scale the long radical rewrite fits the narrow text column, and formula/prose wrapping remains coherent throughout the three affected sections.
The inline multiplier stays together while its surrounding prose wraps; the kinetic-energy and mass-change expressions sit on distinct prose lines without visible overlap.
Equation labels remain beside their formulas, including (8.11), (8.13) and (8.15), which are not fully covered by the mobile viewport captures.
captures.limitation: The image viewer resized this 390x6383 full-page capture to 367x6000. It cannot certify every fine glyph; detailed inspection uses the supplied native-size mobile viewport captures, with no crops or reopens.

observations: The long two-radical rewrite fits on one line with right-side clearance; both radical bars and hooks are visible without touching the preceding or following prose.
Nested fractions, raised square and fourth powers remain separate, with visible bars and no edge truncation.
The inline fourth-order term remains between 'quantity' and 'gives:' without collision; the following shorter radical approximation is fully visible.
Single-symbol wrappers beside 'light' and 'speed', and the low-speed inequality at the end of the introduction, remain coherently attached to their prose.
captures.limitation: The viewport ends after the shorter radical approximation; the later mass approximation and multiplier receive full-page overview coverage only on mobile.

observations: Equation (8.12) is fully visible on one line inside the mobile column, with distinct numerator, main fraction bar, radical denominator and nested squared ratio.
The raised square in the leading energy expression is clear; the equation label remains separate from the fraction.
The introduction wraps before the formula, and the following bold paragraph starts below it with visible clearance; no formula/prose overlap.
captures.limitation: This viewport covers (8.12), not the later (8.13) fraction; the latter receives mobile full-page overview coverage only.

observations: The parenthesized low-speed inequality moves intact to the next prose line without losing its punctuation or colliding with surrounding words.
Equation (8.14) fits on one line, with visible raised squares and a distinct kinetic-term numerator, bar and denominator 2.
The equation label and subsequent explanatory paragraph have visible clearance; neither the formula nor surrounding lines show wrapper clipping or overlap.
captures.limitation: The viewport ends before the rest-energy identity (8.15); that identity receives mobile full-page overview coverage only.

conclusion.basis: No visible affected formula-wrapper defect was found in the eight saved captures. Detailed viewport pixels show intact radicals, separated fractions and superscripts, coherent adjacent spacing/wrapping, and no visible wrapper clipping or overlap. Existing hash-bound DOM bounds evidence is reused, not substituted for pixel inspection.
limitations: This is a bounded affected-only visual PASS, not a fine-glyph certificate for every one of the 24 wrappers in each viewport.
Tall full-page images provide overview coverage only; the mobile full-page image was resized by the viewer.
Supplied viewport captures were used to inspect affected formulas at their displayed viewport scale, but do not cover every formula in the full page.
Content cut at saved viewport screen edges is a capture boundary, not evidence of CSS wrapper clipping.
Saved captures cannot establish live-current CSS, interactive behavior, all viewport sizes, full English accessibility or embedded-font correctness.
Prior source, SCI, ZHEN, answers, options and full display approvals are retained by the parent and were not repeated.

execution.reviewMethod: Offline local saved-image inspection and SHA-256 binding only
